version_guard: No public version was verified: this identity freezes the observed methodology/source snapshot. Review task set, harness, judges, metric and configuration before importing any later result; a changed protocol needs a new identity.

scoring.notes: All test questions are kept private (the board states this), so the task set cannot be inspected. The board states that models which cannot consistently produce writing responses — irreparable repetition, broken outputs or constant refusals — are not given a writing score, so a missing Writing value is an exclusion, not a zero. We did not verify the formula's optimal values or any theoretical bounds.

description: A maintainer-owned writing evaluation considering intelligence, style, repetition and length adherence, informed by human preferences.
